E2.methylation_distance: median absolute CTX-minus-PBS beta difference across frozen C1 carrier probes passing finite support at all 22 weekly states
E2.rna_preprocess: map SYMBOL|ENTREZID to SYMBOL; discard blank/?; aggregate duplicate SYMBOL rows by median per sample; robust-standardize each gene across the 22 frozen weekly states by median and MAD; discard zero/nonfinite MAD
E2.rna_distance: median absolute CTX-minus-PBS robust-z difference across retained genes at each week
E2.phase_test: exact Kruskal-Wallis permutation over all assignments preserving 3/5/3 phase sizes
E2.multiplicity: BH across methylation-distance and RNA-distance phase tests
E2.support_rule: at least one molecular distance has BH q <= 0.05; report the other independently; no direction is pre-imposed

E3.methylation_gene_object: for each gene with frozen promoter-core mapping, median CTX-minus-PBS beta difference across mapped C1 probes at each week
E3.rna_gene_object: CTX-minus-PBS robust-z expression difference per retained gene at each week
E3.gene_intersection: genes with both objects at every required transition; no outcome-based gene filtering
E3.forward: absolute Spearman across genes between methylation_delta(t) and RNA_delta(t+1)
E3.reverse: absolute Spearman across genes between RNA_delta(t) and methylation_delta(t+1)
E3.support_rule: primary statistic > 0 and exact one-sided p <= 0.05
E3.claim_ceiling: temporal-direction asymmetry only; not causal methylation-to-RNA regulation without an independent methylation intervention
